arms.name: random_tail20
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

averaging.method: uniform arithmetic mean of the final 20 parameter states
averaging.snapshots: one full parameter snapshot after every optimizer step; retain only the rolling final 20
averaging.evaluation: evaluate only the final mean, with no intermediate checkpoint selection and no decay hyperparameter
averaging.equal_opportunity: identical snapshot and averaging rule for low, random, and dense
averaging.deployment: ordinary dense inference with averaged weights

cost_accounting.training: same realized-row CPU-calibrated 87.5% FFN sparse-backward formula; dense pays full cost
cost_accounting.snapshot_aux: one parameter-copy operation per model parameter per step for every arm
cost_accounting.final_average_aux: twenty parameter-reduction operations per model parameter, included in final total
cost_accounting.evaluation: identical held-out batches, reported separately from training-plus-averaging cost

primary_endpoint: final uniform-tail ordinary dense held-out loss at training-plus-averaging cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: low_max_abs tail-average loss is not below random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs beats random but not dense tail-average; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs tail-average loss is below random and dense while total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: using EMA in any arm of this experiment
changing tail length, activity, steps, or evaluation after launch
excluding snapshot or final reduction overhead
launching body 7 without a development-level win
